Welcome to El Sabanero
Where transformation begins
Located just outside the lively pace of Tamarindo, El Sabanero offers a peaceful hideaway to rest, reflect and recharge.
Within the tropical beauty of Costa Rica, our curated retreat packages are designed to meet each guest exactly where they are – physically, emotionally and spiritually. We invite travelers to escape the distractions of everyday life to rediscover joy, to cultivate an awareness of life’s true blessings and purposeful living.
From wellness, yoga and detox retreats to corporate leadership development and team-building experiences, each program is personalized to provide an environment that inspires personal growth and lasting well-being.

El Sabanero Bungalows
Enjoy a peaceful stay, minutes from the most famous beaches of Guanacaste. Surrounded by tropical greenery, the lodge features an infinity pool, spacious common areas, and a yoga/workout deck. With 11 bungalows on the property, it’s ideal for solo travelers, couples, or groups looking to rent multiple units. Each bungalow is designed with simplicity in mind and includes air conditioning, a double bed, private bathroom, and a terrace with hammock.
Our team is available throughout your stay to provide recommendations, assist with activity planning, and arrange wellness treatments, ensuring that every detail contributes to a memorable visit.
